sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 610. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Applies Field Protect to the allied Field.
-Target: all allies. Applies 50% elevation for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) by 50% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Siege for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; Applies Vital Strike (10% chance to increase damage dealt by 50%). Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Revolutionary Element (increases max HP by 100%, increases all stats by 100%, increases Ability Power of critical hits by 30, and reduces Ability Cost consumption by 50%) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Status ailment resistance boosted by 35 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 80% for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
Light and Time Defense from Unison Damage +500

[Shrieking Monkey] Fumi Sarukami or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
